item.title: Archive: SSS-Class Revival Hunter, Chapter 84
item.author: 1450169683@qq.com (滑翔闪)
item.description: This archive is SSS-Class Revival Hunter (Chapter 84), found purely by chance. The original is a Korean novel, and the column someone posted on Bilibili was only a machine translation. I stumbled on it, thought it was good, so I asked my classmate cc to polish the language and archived it. In the end I trimmed it to my own taste. The machine translation unexpectedly produced a kind of stream-of-consciousness feel.
